findings.problem: Gerne (or gern) is also a very common one-word reply to danke in Germany, so the hint does not rule it out.
findings.fix: hint: one-word reply to danke, the same word as please (not gerne)

back.target: you're welcome (reply to thanks); also please, here you are, pardon?
back.example: Thanks for the coffee! – You're welcome!

note: Bitte schön and gern geschehen are also common replies, but they are two words, so the one-word part of the hint already rules them out.
